gloss: new model; new type; latest version

definitions.gloss: new model; new type; latest version
definitions.explanation: A newly designed or released version of a product, vehicle, or device. Also used for new strains of viruses.

examples.japanese: {新型|しんがた}のスマホが{発売|はつばい}された。
examples.english: A new model smartphone was released.

examples.japanese: {新型|しんがた}の{車|くるま}は{燃費|ねんぴ}がよくなっている。
examples.english: The new model car has better fuel efficiency.

examples.japanese: {新型|しんがた}ウイルスの{感染|かんせん}が{世界中|せかいじゅう}に{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: The new strain of the virus spread throughout the world.

notes:
{新型|しんがた} refers to a newly developed or recently released version of a product, vehicle, device, or even a biological strain. It emphasizes that something is the updated or current-generation model, as opposed to earlier versions.

STRUCTURE: A compound of {新|しん} (new) + {型|がた} (model, type).

COMPOUNDS:
- {新型|しんがた}{車|しゃ}: new model car
- {新型|しんがた}コロナウイルス: novel coronavirus
- {新型|しんがた}{機種|きしゅ}: new model (of device)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新型|しんがた}: new model/type
- {旧型|きゅうがた}: old model/type
- {最新型|さいしんがた}: latest model
